Production PIXEL ART for the existing Sproto fighting game. Crisp stepped pixels, dark outlines, compact limited-color shading. Not smooth vector or painterly art. Each cell contains exactly ONE complete actor facing RIGHT, consistent three-quarter side view. Preserve the reference identity, facial shape, exact eye count, colors, clothing, accessories and slender long torso. Same head, torso and limb proportions in every frame. Exactly two arms and two legs per actor, legs rooted at the LOWEST pelvis below the belly. Low hip, chambered knee and connected ankle for every kick. Never attach legs to the chest. Keep all limbs and feet wholly inside their own cell with generous empty margins; no clipping. Flat solid pure MAGENTA #ff00ff background, no grid lines, labels, shadows, trails, floating particles or weapons. Worn/held identity accessories must remain attached to body or hand. Extend cropped lower bodies conservatively using matching skin/clothing colors and simple shoes. Complete separate body drawings; no limb cutouts. Both feet need readable soles. No extra subjects.

IDENTITY: Bitcoinium Leviosa is the ONE SPROTO in reference image 1. Preserve the oversized round cobalt-blue head, two large round yellow eyes with small black pupils and white glints, curved blue brows and eyelid lines, wide closed red smiling muzzle with NO teeth, swept RED rear head spikes, and the distinctive bright YELLOW curled forelock with attached yellow oval side ornament. These yellow shapes stay fixed to the head. Preserve the narrow asymmetric body: YELLOW torso and anatomical left arm, LIGHT BLUE anatomical right arm, RED connected bare hands with fingers, and red rounded overlapping chest-and-belly panels down the center. These red shapes are flat attached clothing/body decorations, NOT a second figure or extra limbs. Preserve the same anatomy-relative color assignments when the pose turns. Reference hands are on hips but animate the arms freely. Extend the cropped body conservatively with two slender cobalt-blue legs rooted below the pelvis and simple red feet. Exactly one head, two eyes, two arms, two legs. Exclude lavender background. No hat, wand, cape, coins, logo, text, weapon or fighting gloves. Reference image 2 is the approved combat pose sheet. Match its complete-body proportions, pixel style and colors exactly.

Exactly EIGHT separate full-body drawings in a regular 4-column by 2-row grid. A continuous guarded fighting footwork loop, NOT a run. Upper body stays calm, head/torso size constant, hips stay at the same height and same x center. Both fists remain raised. Feet are clearly different on adjacent frames: 0 near foot forward grounded/far foot back grounded; 1 transfer weight to near sole, far heel lifts; 2 far knee passes under low pelvis with far foot lifted; 3 far foot reaches forward while near sole still supports; 4 far foot forward grounded/near foot back grounded; 5 transfer weight to far sole, near heel lifts; 6 near knee passes under low pelvis with near foot lifted; 7 near foot reaches forward ready to plant. No feet crossing through one another, no sliding torso, no detached hips. Each frame has at least one clearly grounded foot. Last frame loops to first. Same complete body and clothing as the combat reference. Keep the yellow curled forelock and yellow oval ornament firmly attached to the head in every pose. Keep the bright yellow torso, asymmetric yellow/blue arms and central red rounded panels consistent, not a uniform bodysuit. Slim body with very large round head, red rear spikes, closed toothless red smile. All head ornaments, fingers and feet entirely inside their cell. No detached effects or extra bodies.

Row 2 SPECIAL A: low coil; shoulder windup; fully extended straight impact punch; punch retract.
Row 3 SPECIAL B: alternate shoulder strike; retract to cover; two-arm finishing palm thrust to RIGHT; recover combat guard. No floating effects.
Row 4 CAST: hands coil at chest; forward hand chambers; front palm extends RIGHT at chest height; retract to guard. No projectile, sphere or particles; engine supplies effects.
Row 5 RECOIL: chest impact arch; head/torso lean back with arms still connected; bend knees to absorb; regain combat guard.
Row 6 DEFEAT START: staggering upright; knees buckle; dropping toward floor with bent elbows; roll onto side with head and feet fully visible.
Row 7 DEFEAT FLOOR: entirely lying on side, head to LEFT feet to RIGHT; same lying body settles; small final shoulder drop; side-lying completely still. No kneeling or standing in any of these four.
